problem: Studio Retry reloaded its retained signed media URL without asking the existing grant endpoint. An eligible proxy suppresses background proxy polling, so this never refreshed expired access.
change: Retry is an asynchronous Editing Session operation. Refresh only the selected proxy or original-source grant through the scoped API client, then rebind media at the current source-time anchor. Do not refetch bootstrap or replace document/history. Fence late responses by session, media, retry generation, selected asset and clip window. A failed grant remains a playback error.

red.actualCallsite: Existing playback.reload intent called by the Retry callback before the production change
red.result: 0 pass, 1 fail: expected one fresh grant read; received zero

regressions: Eligible proxy refresh preserves edits, undo history, playhead and playing state
Original-source refresh preserves an unsaved trim and does not select the stored proxy
Late proxy results are ignored after trim, close or trim followed by undo
Late source results cannot replace a proxy selected by undo
Failed/missing grants do not reload expired URLs or change asset kind
An older overlapping retry cannot overwrite the latest grant
Cached expired proxy/source descriptors still cause fresh scoped transport reads without bootstrap

An added race fixture assumed the source-fallback flag replaces an eligible proxy. The existing product contract keeps that proxy selected. Replaced the incorrect fixture with an actual source-to-proxy switch via undo; production code was unchanged for this correction
